description: A full account creation form with name, country, birthday, email, and password fields and live password rules.
overview: A full account creation form with name, country, birthday, email and a password with confirmation, grouped into labeled sections. A checklist of password rules appears as the user types, and mismatched passwords turn the fields red. Submitting a valid form shows a success view. Use it when you need more than an email and password at signup.
usage: Replace the success branch with your registration API call. Edit `rules` for the password checklist and the country list inline. The birthday is free text and is never parsed, so swap in a date picker or validate it before sending.
notes: Every field has an autocomplete value so browsers and password managers can fill it, and the form runs its own validation instead of the browser's.
